name: [5D]+1 Speed Car Escape
desc:
🏎️ WELCOME TO +1 SPEED CAR ESCAPE!

🎮 HOW TO PLAY:

⚡ Train your Speed: Train to gain more speed!
⛽ Collect Fuel: Keep your engine running!
🚧 Race: Navigate through challenging obstacle courses!
🚓 Escape: Outrun the POLICE CHASE!
🦋 Unlock: Collect awesome WINGS!

👍 Don't forget to LIKE and ⭐ FAVORITE to support the game!
👥 Join the community group for special rewards!
